title: Feature Gate Prioritizer & SLO Checksheet
content:
Purpose and quick how-to:
This sheet helps Product Ops and PMs decide which feature gates to run, rank them by impact/risk, and enforce SLO-based launch gates. Use as the single source for go/no-go decisions for feature-level rollouts across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private tracks.

Scoring rubric (0-5 for each):
- User Impact (U): how many active customers affected; 5 = cross-enterprise, 1 = single small client
- Revenue Signal (R): direct revenue/ARR impact; 5 = $100k+/mo, 1 = negligible
- Operational Risk (O): probability of SEV or sustained latency increase; 5 = high risk
- Observability Maturity (V): dashboards/evals in place; 5 = telemetry + automated alerts
- Rollout Complexity (C): infra/permissions/migrations; 5 = large infra change

Columns (spreadsheet view):
1) Feature | 2) Short description | 3) PM | 4) U | 5) R | 6) O | 7) V | 8) C | 9) Total score | 10) Primary KPI | 11) Baseline (last 30d) | 12) Launch target | 13) SLO gate condition | 14) Metric owner | 15) Rollout plan | 16) Canaries | 17) Contingency

Sample rows (examples):
- Feature: streaming-fallback-priority | Desc: tiered fallback for streaming when GPU mem pressure detected | PM: Maya Singh | U:4 | R:3 | O:3 | V:4 | C:2 | Total:16 | KPI: 95th pct latency (ms) | Baseline: 210 ms | Target: <=240 ms | SLO: 95th pct < 300ms sustained over 5m window | Metric owner: Ethan Park | Rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days | Canaries: eu-west-1 + two enterprise orgs | Contingency: auto-rollback to previous variant if SLO tripped twice in 1h

- Feature: kv-cache-prefetch | Desc: prefetch hot prefixes into KV cache on model load | PM: Lucas Reed | U:3 | R:2 | O:2 | V:3 | C:3 | Total:13 | KPI: token generation cost ($/k token) | Baseline: $0.42 | Target: <=$0.37 | SLO: cost regression <= +3% vs baseline and accuracy delta <= 0.5% on eval set | Metric owner: Ava Martinez | Rollout: internal alpha -> beta partners -> general | Canaries: internal + staging | Contingency: disable prefetching and revert cache policy

Decision rules (automated):
- Auto-approve roll to next increment if: no SLO breaches in last 24h across all canaries AND KPI trend within target bounds for rolling 1d and 7d windows.
- Auto-halt if: any SLO breach in canary OR 95th pct latency > SLO for 10m OR error rate spike > 2x baseline sustained 5m.
- Manual review required when total score >= 18 or Operational Risk >= 4.

Pre-launch checklist (per-feature):
- [ ] Metric dashboards created with owner and edit links
- [ ] Synthetic regression tests (prompt set) checked in to evaluations repo
- [ ] Canaries and test customers identified and notified
- [ ] Runbook drafted with rollback steps and exec summary (1-pager)
- [ ] Audit log and telemetry retention validated for Private deployments
- [ ] Compliance review if PII surfaces (security signoff)
- [ ] Billing and quota implications documented with Finance (predicted cost delta)
- [ ] Post-launch experiment definition (A/B metrics + duration)

Gate checklist example (streaming-fallback-priority):
1) Dashboards: latency_by_model, errors_by_region, cost_by_customer — links in linked_artifacts
2) Eval set: passes accuracy delta <= 0.4% (regression tests)
3) Load test: 75th/95th latency under target with traffic mix spike at +30% sustained 10m
4) Security: tokenization and prompt redact validated (security signoff id: SEC-2024-112)
5) Ops: rollback validated in staging with <5m RTO

KPI definitions (must be unambiguous):
- 95th pct latency (ms): server-side time from request accepted to last token emitted; measured per model variant, aggregated by 5m windows.
- Error rate: proportion of requests with HTTP 5xx or model runtime exception; filtered to exclude known test clients.
- Cost per 1k tokens: infra + GPU amortized cost normalized to token count using accounting query: cost_tokens_v2 (link: GHA:cost-query-v2).
- Quality delta: eval harness score compared to pinned baseline (eval-id referenced in linked_artifacts).

Post-launch monitoring and retro cadence:
- First 24h: metric check every 30m by oncall engineer, PM summary at 6h and 24h.
- Day 2-7: daily pulse report + one inspection meeting at day 3.
- Week 2: retro focused on ops incidents, cost drift, and customer feedback; decide whether to accelerate rollout or pause.

Quick queries and dashboard links (placeholders to replace with real ids):
- Latency by variant: confluence/dashboard/latency-variant-2024
- Error spike alert: /alerts/ops/error-rate-spike
- Cost daily rollup: /billing/summary/cost-per-feature

Notes and common pitfalls observed at Redwood:
- Don’t rely solely on average latency; 95th and tail behavior correlate strongly with user-perceived regressions for streaming workloads.
- Small canary cohorts can hide distro issues for multi-tenant customers; always include an enterprise org or two in the early canaries when U >=4.
- Telemetry gaps are the most frequent cause of delayed rollbacks — ensure metric ownership exists before rollout.

Action items (next three weeks):
- PMs to fill this sheet for every feature landing in Q4 by Nov 8.
- Product Ops to run a triage workshop on Nov 10 with infra and SRE to validate rollout plans.
- Create a reusable dashboard template and alert playbook by Nov 20 (owner: Ethan Park).

Revision history (notes):
- 2024-11-01: initial draft by Ava Martinez
- 2024-11-06: added rollback heuristics and scoring rubric (Maya Singh)
- 2024-11-12: finalized gate checklist and pre-launch items (Ethan Park)

Contact / owner notes:
If you have questions about scoring or need help wiring dashboards, ping #prodops-launch or reach out to Ava Martinez (ava@redwood.ai) or Ethan Park (ethan@redwood.ai).
